articles.title: BitGo stock surges on $50 million share buyback as value languishes 65% below IPO price
articles.snippet: The buyback comes as newly public digital-asset firms face a tougher environment, with crypto markets lagging and investor attention shifting toward AI stocks.

articles.title: A new Bittensor proposal would turn validators into something like fund managers
articles.snippet: Root Reborn would have TAO validators pick which subnets to back and reinvest yield into, rather than constantly selling subnet tokens to pay stakers. It is a code proposal in review, not a live change.

articles.title: SpaceX's $2.6 trillion market cap nearly double that of bitcoin
articles.snippet: Eight days after its IPO, SpaceX has surged past $2.5 trillion to become the world's sixth-largest company. And market watchers say it is pulling the risk capital crypto wants.

articles.title: Crypto PAC has $12M stake in Senate primary runoff as Alabama voters head to polls
articles.snippet: Defend American Jobs reported spending $7.4 million on media to support Republican Barry Moore ahead of his May 19 Alabama primary, and an additional $4.7 million before Tuesday’s runoffs.

articles.title: Uniswap Jumps Double Digits as Standard Chartered Eyes $100 UNI by 2030
articles.snippet: The DeFi token is up 20% in a day, with a Standard Chartered note and Uniswap's tokenized-stock launch fueling fresh demand.
